{
  "findings": [
    {
      "deletion_test": "Removing the unlimited capability and absence-of-bloat claim preserves the concrete claim that Caddy has a highly extensible modular architecture.",
      "diagnosis": "The wording turns extensibility into an unsupported promise of unlimited functionality with no added overhead.",
      "evidence": "The overview describes Go applications implemented as Caddy modules and a plugin system, but establishes neither unlimited capabilities nor an absence of bloat.",
      "line": 92,
      "quote": "lets Caddy do anything without bloat",
      "source_function": "promotion"
    },
    {
      "deletion_test": "The comparison needs correction rather than wholesale deletion: the implementation language and memory-safety rationale are useful information worth preserving.",
      "diagnosis": "The sentence compares a programming language with servers, leaving the basis and scope of the memory-safety comparison unclear.",
      "evidence": "The grammatical subject of the comparison is Go, described as 'a language,' while its comparison target is 'other servers.' The page identifies no particular servers or implementation languages.",
      "line": 94,
      "quote": "a language with higher **memory safety guarantees** than other servers",
      "source_function": "supported capability"
    },
    {
      "deletion_test": "Removing this sentence preserves the following concrete explanation of control over initialized values, HTTP handlers, TLS handshakes, and storage.",
      "diagnosis": "The sentence asserts absolute superiority over every existing web server without supplying comparative evidence.",
      "evidence": "The next sentence explains how Caddy exposes configuration values, but does not establish that this control is unprecedented or exceeds every other server.",
      "line": 185,
      "quote": "Caddy exposes an unprecedented level of control compared to any web server in existence.",
      "source_function": "promotion"
    },
    {
      "deletion_test": "Removing the comparative clause preserves the claim that Caddy is extensible and has a powerful plugin system.",
      "diagnosis": "The clause claims substantial improvements over competing servers without identifying what improves or which servers are being compared.",
      "evidence": "The page describes modular architecture and plugins but gives no comparison supporting 'vast improvements.'",
      "line": 185,
      "quote": "that makes vast improvements over other web servers",
      "source_function": "promotion"
    },
    {
      "deletion_test": "Removing the exclusivity claim preserves the description of Cloudsmith's service and the separate acknowledgment that it provides Debian package repository hosting.",
      "diagnosis": "The exclusive market-position claim is unsupported by the page.",
      "evidence": "The preceding sentence establishes Cloudsmith's hosting contribution. Neither that acknowledgment nor the service description compares Cloudsmith with other package management providers.",
      "line": 225,
      "quote": "the only",
      "source_function": "promotion"
    }
  ],
  "page_id": "caddy",
  "source_sha256": "0bc5939a26994a481e65b84b4e1b9ee44dd06796df4a196c75e9bdcdd4868b18"
